title: Concept: Pickle-backed store opened via shelve.open (python) — review required
description: In python, shelve.open fronts a database with pickle for every value it stores and loads. When the file lives where another principal can write — a shared temporary directory, an upload path, a network share — the reader deserializes attacker-chosen bytes and pickle reconstructs arbitrary objects, which is code execution at load time. The open call is the point where that trust decision is made.
applicability: python services that persist objects in a shelf path they do not exclusively own.
risk: Code execution through pickle deserialization; HIGH severity.
